literal: In the way that is possible, virtuous action, without ceasing, in every opportunity that goes, do.
translation: Perform virtuous deeds without ceasing, in every possible way and at every opportunity.
modern: இயன்ற வழிகளில் எல்லாம் அறச் செயல்களை இடைவிடாமல், அவை செய்யக்கூடிய இடங்கள் மற்றும் வாய்ப்புகள் அனைத்திலும் செய்ய வேண்டும்.
explanation: This couplet emphasizes the continuous practice of virtue in daily life. The term 'ஒல்லும் வகையான்' means 'by whatever means possible', suggesting that one should not wait for grand circumstances but do whatever small good is within their power. 'ஓவாதே' means 'without ceasing', highlighting that virtue is a constant practice rather than an occasional act. 'செல்லும்வாய் எல்லாம்' refers to every opportunity or place where it is possible to act righteously. Thus, the couplet instructs us to perform good deeds continuously, using every available means and opportunity.
